## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] `cargo xtask gen` was run if a finding, a contract type or the command line changed
- [ ] New texts exist in every language
- [ ] A decision record was added if the architecture changed
